title: Former Israeli PM Claims Starlink Receivers Were Secretly Moved Into Iran
author: Sarah Jenkins
excerpt: Former Israeli Prime Minister Naftali Bennett says Israel secretly smuggled Starlink satellite internet receivers into Iran to help protesters bypass government internet restrictions.

title: Google Slashes AI Plus Pricing and Expands Storage in New Challenge to AI Subscription Rivals
author: Alex Thorne
excerpt: Google has reduced the price of its AI Plus subscription while doubling included cloud storage, intensifying competition in the rapidly growing AI subscription market.

title: Snap Unveils $2,195 AR Glasses as Spiegel Pushes Beyond Smartphones
author: Evan Spiegel
image: /images/news/Snap Unveils $2,195 AR Glasses as Spiegel Pushes Beyond Smartphones.webp
excerpt: Snap has introduced its new Specs augmented reality glasses priced at $2,195, as CEO Evan Spiegel doubles down on the belief that AR glasses will eventually replace smartphones as the primary computing platform.

title: UK Information Commissioner Quits Following Probe Into Inappropriate Workplace Humour
author: Jessica Wu
image: /images/news/UK Data and AI Regulator Resigns After Investigation.webp
excerpt: UK Information Commissioner John Edwards has resigned after an independent investigation found his workplace conduct fell below expected standards, raising questions about leadership at a critical time for AI regulation.

title: Google Releases Surprise Android 17 Beta 4.1 Update for Pixel Devices
author: Alex Thorne
excerpt: Google released Android 17 Beta 4.1 for Pixel devices with stability fixes, performance improvements and bug patches as the operating system nears launch.

title: I Tested AI Glasses in Paris. Here's What They Got Wrong
author: Emily Rodriguez
excerpt: A real-world test of AI-powered smart glasses in Paris revealed both impressive capabilities and notable shortcomings, highlighting the challenges facing the next generation of wearable artificial intelligence devices.

title: Jeff Bezos Predicts AI Will Lead to Worker Shortages, Not Job Losses
author: Tech Desk
image: /images/news/Jeff Bezos Says AI Will Create Labor Shortages.webp
excerpt: Jeff Bezos told audiences at VivaTech that artificial intelligence is more likely to create labor shortages than widespread unemployment, arguing that technological progress historically generates new industries and jobs.

title: Meta AI Companion App Contains Hidden Facial Recognition Feature for Smart Glasses, Raising Privacy Concerns
author: Robert Miller
excerpt: Meta has embedded a dormant facial recognition system, called NameTag, in its AI companion app for Ray-Ban and Oakley smart glasses. The feature is inactive but raises privacy and surveillance concerns.
